successCriteria.description: `IEmployeeService.getMe(): Promise<EmployeeProfile>` delegates to the injected `IApiClient.getMe()` and returns its typed result unchanged (no transformation, no re-fetch, no local type re-declaration).

`ILeaveService.list(): Promise<LeaveRequestView[]>` delegates to `IApiClient.getLeaves()` and `ILeaveService.getById(id): Promise<LeaveRequestView>` delegates to `IApiClient.getLeave(id)`, each returning the typed result unchanged.
`IBalanceService.getBalances(): Promise<LeaveBalanceView[]>` delegates to `IApiClient.getBalances()` and returns the typed result unchanged.

Vitest unit tests exist for each service asserting it calls the correct `IApiClient` method exactly once (with the correct argument for `getById`) and returns the typed result; a fake `IApiClient` is used, no network.

Barrel files `web/src/modules/employee/index.ts` and `web/src/modules/leave/index.ts` re-export the service interfaces and implementations (employee: IEmployeeService/EmployeeService; leave: ILeaveService/LeaveService/IBalanceService/BalanceService).
`npm run build` in `web/` succeeds with zero TypeScript errors and the Vitest suite passes; no file under `src/` (backend) is modified.

constraints: Services are read-only delegating wrappers: no create/submit/approve/reject/cancel operations, no state mutation, no token storage access, no transaction/unit-of-work usage.
Each service constructor takes exactly one injected dependency, `IApiClient` (from `web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts`); no other collaborators are injected.
Types (`EmployeeProfile`, `LeaveRequestView`, `LeaveBalanceView`) are imported from `web/src/shared/types/index.ts`; they are never re-declared, widened, or narrowed locally.

Modules import only through public entry points (`web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts`, `web/src/shared/types/index.ts`); no import of `api-client.ts`/`token-storage.ts` internals, and no circular dependency between employee and leave modules.
No `any` (use `unknown` with guards); strict TypeScript (noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks) must hold.
outOfScope: Any state-changing leave operations (create/submit/approve/reject/cancel) and any balance mutation — the frontend is read-only for leave requests and balances.
Presentation layer (router, pages, guards, components) — Phase 5; these services expose no React components or hooks.
Auth module changes (login/logout/session/context) — Phase 3; these services do not manage tokens or sessions.
Any backend (`src/`) change, new HTTP endpoints, or new API-client methods — the services consume only the existing `IApiClient` surface.

ambiguities.description: Whether the service methods should be declared `async` and `await` the client call, or return the client promise directly (both satisfy "delegates and returns the typed result").
options: declare async and await the client call

ambiguities.description: Where the Vitest test files live (co-located `*.test.ts` next to each service vs a single test file), given the phase lists ~6 files but tests are required.
options: one combined test file per module

entityInvariants.invariant: Returned verbatim from the API client; the service never adds, removes, or transforms fields (never carries passwordHash or terminationDate, which are absent from the shared type).
Read-only view; the service performs no lifecycle transition and returns the API client's value unchanged (status is display-only).
Read-only view; `available` is display-only and never recomputed or mutated by the service — the value returned by the API client is passed through unchanged.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: None at this layer — the API client attaches the bearer token and handles 401; the service adds no auth logic.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Propagates the API client's error (ApiError) unchanged; no swallowing, mapping, or retry.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Service method signatures and return types must match the existing `IApiClient` methods exactly (getMe/getLeaves/getLeave/getBalances) so delegation is type-safe with no casts.
`EmployeeProfile`, `LeaveRequestView`, `LeaveBalanceView` must be imported from the shared types module and used as-is (no local re-declaration), matching the canonical field shapes.
`IApiClient` must be imported from the public barrel (not `api-client.ts` directly), consistent with the module-boundary rule and the existing auth service's import style.
Service interface/implementation naming and constructor-injection style must mirror the existing `AuthService` (interface + class, injected `IApiClient`), keeping the module conventions uniform.

integrationPoints.why: The sole data source for all three services; every service method delegates to a corresponding IApiClient method.
Canonical client-side DTOs (EmployeeProfile, LeaveRequestView, LeaveBalanceView) that the services return.
DashboardPage/LeaveListPage/LeaveDetailPage will consume these services via their barrels; the interfaces are the contract those pages depend on.
